ecosystem.notes: The 10-K states GDV rounded, as $9.8T. It also gives three program rows (Consumer Credit, Consumer Debit and Prepaid, Commercial Credit and Debit), which were not added up. GDV is the spend on Mastercard-branded cards, and the 10-K notes that the GDV data is 'provided by Mastercard customers'. Mastercard is a network, not a marketplace: issuing banks, acquirers and merchants keep most of the economics, so net revenue divided by GDV is a network fee rate, not a share of the sale. GDV excludes Maestro and Cirrus.
ecosystem.ratioNote: Mastercard net revenue includes value-added services and solutions that are not charged on gross dollar volume, so net revenue ÷ GDV is not a like-for-like share.
